text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A small-scale fan meetup regularly held at the academy.
I was assigned to work as part of the staff.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see! So the three of us will be greeting
and welcoming the fans this time...
desne!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna get su~per hyped up
with everyone☆
Like performing a mini live together!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm hmm, the venue is the outdoor stage.
In that case, feng shui-wise...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, thoughts of what happened last time cross my mind.
I can't let myself get overly nervous and mess up again...
The more I think that, the more—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Could it be that you're feeling... anxious, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...I understand.
I feel the exact same way—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—is what I was about to say, but no!
I want to boldly go in brimming with confidence instead!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's true that last time, we both got nervous together
...and ended up stumbling along the way.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, learning from that lesson—
this time, I will act with total confidence instead!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That way, I might be able to share some of my
positive energy with you too, Trainer-san.
...So!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Let's do this~! Ohhh~! Ganbarou!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Something like that, how does it sound?
...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Buena Vista's cheerful energy spread
not just to me, but to everyone else as well—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they'll do today~.
Can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Heh, it'll probably just be the same old stuff.
As someone who comes every time, I'd know...!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Ngh?! Th-This music is...?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista & Others
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa-ta-daaa☆!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone~☆
Thanks for coming out today☆!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The weather and the flow of ki are both perfect today!
Have as much fun as you can!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's start with the parade♪
Trainer-san, release the balloons!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!" "Awesome!"
"They're way more fired up than usual~!"
"Heh, not half bad...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the preparation we did together,
the event was a massive hit from opening to closing!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... The fans
looked so happy, desu ne.
choice_data_list: Thank you so much. To everyone, and to you.
Thank you so much. To everyone, and to you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. If anything, I'm the one
who should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing those who try their best find happiness
in proportion to their hard work... Witnessing such a wonderful sight—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Has filled me with so much warmth and contentment.
Truly.
choice_data_list: A-A halo of light is blinding me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Has filled me with so much warmth and contentment.
Truly.
choice_data_list: A-A halo of light is blinding me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Oh, don't say that. The one who's truly kind is—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You, Trainer-san, for working so hard
for everyone's sake up until today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Those words could only come from someone truly kind—
Basking in Buena Vista's warmhearted nature,
my heart felt deeply comforted.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Trainer-san, are you alright?!
Did something get in your eye...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista's almost dazzling kindness—
While it brought immense healing, it also naturally
made me want to stand tall and do my very best.
